2609.05016.title: Amortizing Scaling Law Construction Costs
2609.05016.paper_summary: Scaling laws guide the design choices for training large foundation models, but deriving them involves training an exhaustive grid over hyperparameters, token budgets, and parameter counts, which is computationally expensive. Fitting a scaling law, however, only requires the best-loss frontier across compute scales, discarding most of the trained configurations. We propose a framework for efficient scaling law construction that formulates data collection as a Bayesian optimization problem, and introduce metrics for comparing scaling law fitting methods under constrained compute budgets. We find that progressively expanding the compute budget during acquisition, mirroring the compute-ordered evaluation of configurations in practice, substantially improves recovery efficiency. Augmenting the observed configurations with surrogate-fantasized evaluations then recovers the broader experimental grid, allowing accurate scaling law fitting without training every configuration. Together, these can closely match scaling law fits over a full dense grid at computational savings of up to $10\text{--}100\times$.
2609.05016.paper_summary_zh: 擴展法則指導大型基礎模型的訓練設計選擇，但推導它們需要對超參數、標記預算和參數計數進行全面的網格訓練，這在計算上是昂貴的。然而，擬合擴展法則只需要在計算規模上獲得最佳損失邊界，並丟棄大多數訓練配置。我們提出了一個高效的擴展法則構建框架，將數據收集公式化為貝葉斯優化問題，並引入了在受限計算預算下比較擴展法則擬合方法的指標。我們發現，在獲取過程中逐步擴大計算預算，模仿實踐中配置的計算有序評估，顯著提高了恢復效率。然後，通過用替代的幻想評估增強觀察到的配置，恢復更廣泛的實驗網格，從而在不訓練每個配置的情況下實現準確的擴展法則擬合。這些方法可以在計算節省高達 $10\text{--}100\times$ 的情況下，與完整的密集網格上的擴展法則擬合緊密匹配。
